subject: prd/implement-now
statement: When a ready plan/v2 task is considered for implementation, the executor shall recover the task's complete frozen assessment, evidence citations, execution profile, derivation-policy version, and planner-raise evidence from the projected carrier, compare them field-for-field with the frozen plan record, and pass them into the implementation attempt without reinterpretation.
rationale: planning owns task semantics; execution transports and consumes the frozen minimum rather than inferring complexity from charter prose
fit_criterion: every supported tracker projection round-trips every demand field byte-identically; missing, changed, or native dispatch data produces zero task claims and names the boundary and field; a mechanical task follows the same path
